summary.tldr: Excludes campground businesses from the Income Tax Act rule that defines certain businesses as specified investment businesses.
what_it_does: Changes the definition of “specified investment business” in subsection 125(7) of the Income Tax Act so it no longer includes a campground business.
Keeps campground businesses outside the part of the definition that covers businesses mainly earning income from property.
summary.background: The bill amends the definition of “specified investment business” in subsection 125(7) of the Income Tax Act.
